additional_info.subject: RE: ID0427432-DC/Si-D/NZ- [Y2 / R5 313057100005] TB17 Failed/ FB2 has tripped CRM:01282001010
additional_info.body:
Hi Vaishnavy
Our electrician Glen has carried out some fault finding on the charger. Here is his report
I checked the connections detailed by emobility support and found the wiring to be correct and the terminations tight.
I checked the resistance of the earth wires, from TB17 terminals to  -XD103 earth and chassis. The resistance of the AC input earth was below 0.5 ohms but the earth on the output of TB17 was consistently around 14 ohms. I traced this wire back to terminal strip XD4 and re-terminated it, which brought the resistance to below 0.5 ohms. Visually, the termination seemed ok and only measuring it with a multimeter showed the 14 ohm issue.
Checked the other earth terminations on XD4 and all were fine.
From all this I assume the 24V DC supply is designed to have its negative, earthed.
Hi-res photo attached.
Regards
Glen
We have replaced the PSU so we can continue to commission this charger. Can you arrange for a new PSU to be sent to us please. We also need to invoice the time Glen has spent replacing the PSU and fault finding. Can you supply a Purchase Order this please.
Thanks
Liz

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0427432-DC/Si-D/NZ- [Y2 / R5 313057100005] TB17 Failed/ FB2 has tripped CRM:01282001010
additional_info.body:
Good Morning Liz,
Thank you for the report.
Would be able to provide us with a field service report, whereby the details of the below are copied in and the hours spent (and parts consumed) are detailed.
Siemens emobility field service report | MoreApp
We will then use this for raising the PO.
It was unclear to me, but would you be able to verify that there is a good/strong connection from terminal block XD4 (terminal 1-4) to PE, either to the charger chassis or directly on the PE that is connected to the charger.
Based on how the power supply failed, it appears as if the ground connection was only via the chassis of the PSU to the DIN rail (chassis of the charger).
Or a component near the mounting points of power supply let go.
With Kind Regards,

Application Service Engineer
